dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Oh, you're that Forest Watcher's friend, are you? My apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: I'm referring to a Trainee Forest Ranger who's been stationed with us.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: She was here as part of her recuperation process from the first, so I reckon that she'll be leaving now that she's recovered.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Now, she has said that she wouldn't mind staying on as a Forest Ranger, but you know — people change their minds all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: You can't even trust what the sages say nowadays, so I'm not sure how hopeful I should be about anyone or anything else, you know?
